title: v5.103.4 shipped: Measure the harm not the proxy: preset-lockout telemetry + short-cycle rollover persistence
summary: Measure the harm not the proxy: preset-lockout telemetry + short-cycle rollover persistence
why: Two built-not-shipped instruments that gate the rest of HVAC-SUPPLE-SEQUENCE-1. Lockout telemetry forks the arc: non-zero zone_1 lockout count confirms HVAC-PRESET-LOCKOUT-ESCAPE-1 (write never attempted) as the residual-46% cause; near-zero refutes it. Shipped with short-cycle rollover persistence because that is step 4's cycle-count guard and must be live before the conditioning tap is judged. Both instruments, zero behaviour change, build-implies-ship, operator go. Gate: 98/98 both surfaces under .venv-ha; full-suite name-diff byte-identical to v5.103.3.
implications: Shipped HVAC-PRESET-LOCKOUT-TELEMETRY-1, HVAC-ANOMALY-BLIND-1 at v5.103.4; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.4.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: activity ledger has >=1 preset_change_locked_out row AND the daily lockout counter is non-zero for a real zone within ~24h; AND a metric_baselines read shows a short_cycle_rate sample surviving a restart. Read the DB, not the info log.

refs.release_notes:
- HVAC-PRESET-LOCKOUT-TELEMETRY-1: instrument the should_change_preset refusal site (edge-triggered activity row + daily counter), discriminating lockout (manual, refused) from benign no-op (already at target)
- HVAC-ANOMALY-BLIND-1 residual B4: persist daily short_cycle_rate at the rollover, not only at clean teardown (step 4 cycle-count guard)
- No behaviour change; both are instruments. 98/98 tests green; full-suite name-diff vs v5.103.3 identical (zero new failures)
